en.html:
Zeniarai Benten was a peculiar shrine inside a cave. Wash your money in the spring at the back, they said, and the amount would double. A very generous blessing. Also a small attack on the entire principle of money.

Around this financial miracle, the houses were mostly modest. Seedha bol: poor-looking. Dried-out wooden houses, all of them. One matchstick, and the lane could become altogether too lively.

Ritsu's family ran a small general store among them. Household necessities, food, stationery—whatever you needed for getting through an ordinary day, they generally had it. The usefulness of that shop, do not underestimate.

Business was good enough to let their daughter spend her time playing. If she <ruby>really<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> started playing, though, some loan shark would have the shop as security within three days.

That level of recreation was for a company president's young master, with buildings along the coastal line. Not for the general-store class of citizen.

We contributed to the shop's prosperity too. Already cheap, then a friends' discount on top—why should we drag ourselves to the supermarket on the main road? And when they generously handed over the leftovers, even that question became unnecessary.

Only, one small consideration.

ja.html:
銭洗弁天とは洞窟の中にある変わったお社で、その
奥の湧き水でお金を洗うと倍になるというありがたい
ような色々ぶち壊しのようなご利益で知られている。

　そのわりに、近隣の家は慎ましい造りのものが多く、
より素直に言えば貧乏くさい。
　マッチ一本でとても楽しいことになりそうなくらい
枯れた木造建築ばかりだ。

　リツの家はその中で小さな雑貨屋を営んでいる。
　生活用品を中心に食品、文房具など、日常的に必要
となる物品全般を取り扱っているので、その重宝ぶり
たるや只事ではない。

　娘を遊ばせておけるのは店が充分に繁盛していれば
こそだった。……といっても、もしリツが<ruby>本当に<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>遊び
始めたら、雑貨屋は三日でどこかの高利貸しの抵当に
入ってしまうだろうが。

　そんな真似が許されるのは臨海ラインにビルを持つ
社長さんちのご令息くらいに違いない。

　雑貨屋の繁盛にはおれたちも一役買っている。
　もともと安めの値段設定がさらに友達割引されるの
なら、わざわざ大路のスーパーなんぞに足を運ぶ理由
は全くないからだ。

　余り物を気前良くくれたりするとなればなおのこと。
　とはいえ。

en.html:
The wind was cold. I went back over our talk with Ritsu's parents. Neither of them had any real idea.

Ritsu had not come home since she left for school yesterday morning.

So that was one full day, whereabouts unknown, and it had never happened before. She played around, she slept out sometimes, but she had never skipped showing her face to family and friends every single day.

小夏"..."
忠保"Assault: twenty-four hours with no contact is odd. If she was too badly hurt to get home, the hospital should contact her family."
忠保"Badly hurt, and nobody took her to a hospital... that goes into the next case."
雄飛"..."
忠保"Murder. But here also, think. Killing someone is easy. Dealing with what comes afterward is difficult. Normally, it is discovered quickly."
忠保"A dead body is a very conspicuous thing. In a city like Kamakura, one appearing and nobody noticing for an entire day—that probability should be quite low."
